WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        toYear(f.DateKey) AS yr,
        sum(f.SalesAmount)                                                      AS total_sales,
        sum(f.TotalCost)                                                        AS total_cost,
        (sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost)) * 100.0
            / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0)                                     AS gm_pct
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    JOIN retail.DimProduct p          ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps
        ON toInt64(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) IN (2007, 2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName, yr
)
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    round(maxIf(gm_pct, yr = 2007), 2)                                         AS gm_pct_2007,
    round(maxIf(gm_pct, yr = 2008), 2)                                         AS gm_pct_2008,
    round(maxIf(gm_pct, yr = 2009), 2)                                         AS gm_pct_2009,
    round(maxIf(gm_pct, yr = 2008) - maxIf(gm_pct, yr = 2007), 2)             AS yoy_change_2007_2008_pp,
    round(maxIf(gm_pct, yr = 2009) - maxIf(gm_pct, yr = 2008), 2)             AS yoy_change_2008_2009_pp
FROM category_year
GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY ProductCategoryName
